integrity_note: General proof uses an exact orbit triangulation, graph folds and the cited source theorem. A reproducible finite verifier checks small cases but is not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary independence complex of the specified linear single-row hexagon chain and its Klein-four symmetries is covered.
The sphere-wedge conclusions give ordinary fixed-space homotopy types, not integral equivariant stable spectra or PL sphere-wedge homeomorphisms.
The source ordinary homotopy theorem is used as a published input; full independent mathematical verification has not occurred.
Equivalent research not indexed in the searched sources remains a possibility.
title: Parity-switched geometric fixed spaces of hexagonal-chain independence complexes
